maddeler.e:
نتخاذل (form VI)
# نَتَخَاذَلُ (nataḵāḏalu) /na.ta.xaː.ða.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَخَاذَلَ (taḵāḏala)
# نَتَخَاذَلَ (nataḵāḏala) /na.ta.xaː.ða.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَخَاذَلَ (taḵāḏala)
# نَتَخَاذَلْ (nataḵāḏal) /na.ta.xaː.ðal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَخَاذَلَ (taḵāḏala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
